_comment: Reference-point catalogue for the project location maps. Each entry is a real, publicly named place on the Costa del Sol. Beaches are deliberately absent: a beach is a line, not a point, so the beach row is resolved per plot from live OSM beach geometry instead -- coordinates are geocoded once by scripts/build_location_maps.mjs (Nominatim) and cached in "ll" so builds are deterministic and offline. Never hand-edit "ll" to make a distance look better: the figures on the page are routed from these coordinates and must stay checkable. "category" drives ledger order and which of the six rows an entry can fill. "proper" is the place name as it must appear in every language -- place names never translate, only the category word around them.
